description: 法国推进变 C02 — 识别空间挤压信号：坏象诞生

intro.popup_en: Space Cramping, Lesson 1: How can you tell which side is cramped? Track Black's bishop on c8: it has been restricted since the first move and remains trapped ten moves later. This is a clear signal of a space disadvantage.
intro.popup:
空间挤压 第1课

如何识别谁被挤压了？

跟踪黑方c8象的命运：
它从第1手就开始被封锁
10手之后仍然动弹不得！

这就是空间挤压最直观的信号。

outro.popup_en: Three signs of a cramped position are a bad bishop blocked by its own pawns, a knight forced onto an awkward route such as ...Nge7 instead of ...Nf6, and an imbalance in development. When these signs appear, one side is being restricted by lack of space.
outro.popup:
空间挤压识别总结

三个信号：
① 坏象——被自己兵封锁
② 马被迫绕路——Nge7代替Nf6
③ 发展不对称——对方全线出动

看到这些信号 = 有人被空间挤压！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center, one of the most forceful opening moves.
moves.popup: e4 占中心！开局最有力的第一步

moves.popup_en: ...e6! A hallmark of the French Defense. It blocks the c8-h3 diagonal and begins to restrict Black's bishop.
moves.popup:
e6！法国防御的标志。

注意：e6封锁了c8-h3对角线
c8象从此开始受限！

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black challenges the center. Together, e6 and d5 create a second barrier that further blocks the bishop on c8.
moves.popup:
d5 反中心！

e6 + d5 形成双层封锁
c8象的出路被堵死了！

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances a wedge. The chain e6-d5-e5 completes a three-pawn blockade that traps the bishop on c8. The square f6 is also blocked, so Black's knight cannot develop naturally to f6.
moves.popup:
e5！白方推进楔子！

三重封锁完成：e6 + d5 + e5
c8象彻底困死！

而且 f6格被封——
黑马再也不能走Nf6！

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black must counterattack. Challenging d4 is the strongest way to resist White's space advantage.
moves.popup:
c5！黑方必须反击！
攻击d4是此局最有力的抗衡

moves.popup_en: c3 supports d4 and stabilizes White's center.
Nf3 defends d4 and keeps White's position solid.
...Qb6 attacks d4 and creates pressure. Notice that the bishop on c8 is still undeveloped.
moves.popup:
Qb6 攻击d4！黑方施压
注意：c8象仍然没有动！

moves.popup_en: Be2 develops freely, unlike Black's restricted bishop.
moves.popup:
Be2 稳固发展
白方的象可以自由发展！

moves.popup_en: cxd4 exchanges pawns, but even after the exchange Black's bishop remains trapped on c8. A trade alone does not rescue a bad bishop.
moves.popup:
cxd4 兑换！

即使完成兑换……
c8象仍然在原地！
兑换不能解救坏象！

moves.popup_en: cxd4 recaptures and restores White's central control while preserving the e5 wedge.
moves.popup:
cxd4 重新占领中心
白方继续保持e5楔子

moves.popup_en: ...Nge7! The e5-pawn blocks f6, so Black's g8-knight must take the awkward route to e7. A forced detour is a sign of limited space.
moves.popup:
Nge7！

f6格被e5封住了！
g8马只能走e7绕路。

被迫绕路的马
= 空间不足的信号！

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops another knight; White is progressing faster.
moves.popup: Nc3 发展马，白方进度领先

moves.popup_en: Nf5 occupies a good square, but Black's bishop on c8 is still motionless.
moves.popup:
Nf5 马跳好格！
但c8象仍然静止……

moves.popup_en: Na4! White drives away the queen and keeps improving the position.
moves.popup:
Na4！驱逐Qb6
白方不断改善位置

moves.popup_en: ...Qd8 retreats to its original square. Black has lost valuable time.
moves.popup:
Qd8 后被驱回原格
黑方损失了宝贵时间

moves.popup_en: Bd3! White's bishop develops freely to an ideal square. Compare it with Black's bishop on c8, which has not moved in ten moves. This is space cramping: pieces are locked in and unable to act.
moves.popup:
Bd3！白方象自由发展！

对比：
白方象——自由活跃，到达最佳位置
黑方c8象——10手过去，一步未走！

这就是空间挤压：子力被锁住，动弹不得。
